rationale: Georgi and Dev both build abstractions for AI workflow automation—Georgi through Rilo's multi-agent GTM automation platform and Dev through Gooey.AI's low-code AI orchestration. While Georgi focuses on no-code GTM workflows and Dev on broader developer-facing AI tooling, they share conviction in making AI agents accessible and practical for real-world impact, and could explore how their platforms complement each other or exchange learnings on scaling orchestration for different user personas.
intro_message: Georgi, meet Dev Aggarwal, Co-Founder & CTO of Gooey.AI—you're both building low-code/no-code abstractions for multi-agent AI workflows, just aimed at different user groups (GTM teams vs. developers), and could find real synergy on platform design and orchestration philosophy.
